request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: rowdy, ramshackle scrapyard raiders, loud and silly, never grim. Their fixed colours: near-black dark brown leather and patched hide with dirty cream bandage wraps; mismatched rusted iron and dark gunmetal scrap plates with bolts; one signature accent of hazard yellow and black diagonal warning stripes, only as a small striped band on dark scrap, never a solid yellow garment; tiny red-orange fuse sparks. Leather is shaded near-black, iron with darker blue-grey, rust is a dull orange-brown.
layers.negative: gun, rifle, pistol, musket, cannon, modern car, rubber tyres, chrome, headlights, neon, glowing green, lime green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, skull, bones, blood, gore, horror, red tunic, red cloth, yellow tunic, yellow clothes, solid yellow garment, gold armour, blue cloth, purple cloth

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin rocket cart, clearly bigger than a soldier, filling the whole width of the image: one huge fat stubby home-made rocket built from a dented rusty iron barrel of mismatched bolted scrap plates, with one wide band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes round it, a crooked pointed dull grey tin cone cap, a long thin pale stick sticking out behind its tail and a long curly cream fuse with a small red-orange spark at its end; the rocket is tilted up at forty-five degrees, points forward and is tied down with loops of pale cream rope onto a small crooked cart of weathered dark brown planks on two mismatched rusty iron wheels, one big and one small; a tiny goblin with saturated yellow-olive green skin, long pointed ears and a near-black dark brown leather tunic and cap crouches on the ground behind the cart covering its ears; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a home-made scrap rocket on a junk cart, not a modern missile and not a catapult.

layers.negative: missile, steel missile, tail fins, warhead, jet engine, catapult arm, bucket, horse, flames, smoke trail, explosion
